Game Overview

Zombie Grassland puts players into a zombie experience centered on survive the harrowing Zombie Grassland, where waves of undead march endlessly toward you. Embrace your sharpshooting skills as you navigate the eerie terrain, annihilating the horde with precision. Every shot amplifies your score in this gripping, fast-paced expedition through cursed plains. Stay alert, react swiftly, and keep shooting!
